nom: Perricone MD High Potency Triple Retinol Renewal Serum

avis.texte: The best retinol product I've ever used. My insurance covers a prescription retinol (it's been underwhelming), so I was hesitant to start buying this Triple Retinol Serum as it's on the pricey side. After trying the samples I got with another purchase, though, the improvement was pretty noticeable. I finally gave in and purchased it and I'm so happy with the results. I use it nightly and it seems pretty gentle, though I don't have sensitive skin so take that with a grain of salt. Highly recommend this product.

First time using these retinol products and am a long-time Perricone customer. I've been using these about 6 weeks and like the products - not greasy and quickly absorbed. Don't yet see visible results but will update in another 3 months.

avis.titre: The sample sold me on the product
avis.texte: I received samples to try and the results were noticeable. I ordered it and will be using it next.

I've been really impressed with Perricone's Triple Retinol Serum. It feels like a well-made product, and you can tell the quality is there. After using it consistently, I noticed my skin looked smoother and more refined overall. It's effective without feeling harsh, which I really appreciated. Definitely one of those products that feels worth using if you want real results from a retinol serum.
I'm liking the changes to my skin since I started using this retinol product. Unfortunately, though, the eye treatment makes my eyes water,
very high quality brand, I have been using it for 5 years. everything is great
Maintaining my skin. Use on face and neck. Just maintaining. No spectacular results.
No scent, which I like. The serum is light in consistency. The size is portable for travel. A rating of 4 due to the stinging when applied.

avis.titre: Amazing results that don't hurt my skin
avis.texte: Phenomenal and gentle results show within days. One of the things I love about this brand is that every product is immediately absorbed into my skin. No more waiting to start my makeup and the moisture lasts all day.
I expected a better product from Perricone. I am very dissatisfied with this product. The moisturizer cream is a terrible cream; does nothing for your face. Bye Perricone!!!

Started using the product about a week ago and I do see a slight difference so far but it's too early to tell. I probably should purchase the moisturizer and a few of the other products at some point.

avis.titre: Still hands down the best I have found
avis.texte: I have super sensitive skin, also aging skin, fair complexion that is prone to break outs. This stuff is awesome I love it.
I've been using Dr Perricone's products for the past 30 years and always get compliments on my skin. So pleased he has Retinol products!

I got a few packets as samples before I bought the bottle. I noticed immediate results and ordered a full bottle ASAP. It's better than the original formula. Smells a little fishy at first, but that goes away. Not irritating. Fast acting.
my skin is considerably healthier looking and I haven't had break out in months

I have been trying to find the best retinol for my skin and I believe I have! I have been using kiehl's for a while but always seemed heavy. I have combination skin, prone to hormonal acne around my chin/mouth and nearing 50 this helps it all!

I've been using this faithfully everyday and noticed that my skin was better toned, not as dry and just felt better. I didn't notice how much my skin had improved until I ran out. I'm now convinced this serum really works.
I've been wearing this for the past month and in love. My skin is so smooth. The product is light weight which is always a plus

I received this product in exchange of my honest review for free. Packaging is same as other perricone md products which is dark high quality glass bottle with plastic pump and a stopper. Texture is more than perfect, though it claims to be serum but consistency is like gel lotion, absorbs super quickly, no tackiness at all.no fragrance. So in first week of using it my top part of my cheeks go little sensitive which is very common for me, whenever I use some new products with active ingredients, it happens with me. I avoid applying product to that particular part and use slugging method and in week it goes fine. Now it's over a month I'm totally fine. The greatest improvement is overall. Which is mainly the texture of my skin is smooth and even. I'm prone to clog pores, doesn't make any difference in that. But I felt that it do speed up the process of acne hyperpigmentation. Overall I'm enjoying this product.

I replaced my usual serum with the Perricone MD High Potency Triple Retinol Serum and I haven't noticed any difference in my skin texture and appearance. 2 pumps is all you need to cover your neck and face and it applies easily and sinks into your skin without leaving a residue.

avis.titre: Not greasy and makes your skin glow
avis.texte: I love this retinol! It's such a great serum- a little on the thicker side but, does wonders. I really love that it's not greasy and absorbs very quickly. I did notice I have to use 2 full pumps because of this but, I don't mind! My sun spots have started to fade and over all the texture of my skin is like glass.
I used this product for about a month, which I feel like is not long enough to see real results. I will say that I did like the formula, it didn't feel sticky and was very lightweight.

I use this product nightly after cleansing and my toner. I am 44 years old with dry skin, enlarged pores and dullness. I noticed while using this nightly, when I wake up in the morning my skin has more of a glow, less fine lines and my pores are minimized. I love that it is gentler than my rx of trentinoin, which I have stopped using in favor of the Perricone. A little bit goes a long way. When i wake up, I do my regular routine: wash, toner, vitamin c serum, moisturizer and you MUST wear sunscreen.

avis.titre: Amazing one of the best retinol!
avis.texte: This product is amazing I put it on my face before my make up everyday and at night for before bed. This serum leaves my face tight and incredibly soft. I highly recommend this product for anyone that want to rejuvenate there skin.

I received the Perricone md high potency serum for my honest review. I've been using it for a solid 3 weeks and notice that my face feels smoother and plumper. The wrinkles are not as noticeable. The serum doesn't leave a greasy feeling a works well in my daily skin routine. I will purchase it in the future.

I use this cream like serum morning and night before I use any moisturizer. It sinks in instantly and makes my face feel supple before I even add moisture. A few have commented that I look refreshed and that I look like I have foundation on. My face has become even toned and wrinkles WHERE?!

avis.titre: Made a Huge Difference Evening Out My Skin Tone
avis.texte: I used this product twice a day during my AM and PM skin care routine. It was lightweight and spread easily. I only needed 1 pump to cover my face. I used it after cleansing. It absorbed completely into my skin. I followed with my moisturizer. My makeup went on smoothly, and it seemed to stay on better. I noticed a huge difference in my skin tone after using for 10 days. I also noticed a gradual reduction in the fine lines on my forehead.
I started using this product about 8 weeks ago and I can confirm that it has done wonders to my face! Will definitely be stocking up!

avis.titre: Another wonderful product from Perricone MD
avis.texte: The High Potency Triple Retinol Renewal Serum is another great product by Perricone MD. It is non-greasy, no heavy scents and leaves your skins so smooth. After a couple weeks of using as directed, I have noticeably less fine lines. My skin feels moisturized!

This is great high potency cream! It made me look more youthful and smooth skinned! I love it and plan on buying it in the future. I am so thankful I found this wonderful product for my skin to keep up with myself while also aging

I have been using this product for a few weeks now and it feels really nice on your skin. I love that is offers retinol which helps with fine lines. It has also improved the smoothness of my skin. Thanks PerriconeMD for the free product!

I received a full size sample of Perricone MD Triple Retinol Renewal Serum to review exactly one month ago today. I massaged it into my cleansed skin morning and night as instructed.The combination of three types of retinol makes it incredibly effective without casing the irritation I've experienced with other products. My skin feels smoother, looks brighter, and I've noticed a visible reduction in fine lines and wrinkles. One of the standout features for me is the lightweight, silky texture that absorbs quickly and layers beautifully under my moisturizer. I love that it doesn't feel heavy or greasy, or make my skin feel tight and dry like traditional Retina A creams. The only draw back is that I did have to remember to follow with an SPF product after the morning application. Overall, this serum delivers on its promises.
I am almost 40 and barely have any crows feet if any around my eyes and I attribute it to retinol use! This product works well and will be my new go to!

avis.titre: Perricone MD has done it again!!!
avis.texte: I have been using this product for several weeks now, and wow it really works wonders! I added it to my morning and night routine and it has definitely made a difference with my fine lines. It also has made such an improvement with the texture of my skin, making it look smooth and radiant! I absolutely love this serum and will continue to use it and recommend it highly!

I really enjoyed the serum. It was very smooth going on and it made my skin feel very supple and moisturized. I enjoyed using it after I wash my face and it was very easy to blend in to my skin and made my skin very soft. I definitely would recommend this product to someone looking for a great serum That will get their face ready for winter.

avis.titre: Can't believe the results after only a few weeks!
avis.texte: After using this product consistently for two weeks, morning and night, I cannot get over how much different my skin looks. I'm in my mid 30s and have opted out of botox and fillers, but I'm starting to develop fine lines and deep 11s. This product has already made such a difference in my skin and fine lines.
My skin is looking better than ever!! I can't believe how much this product is doing wonders for me. I'm 54 and never felt younger

This is worth considering for those who can invest in a high-quality retinol. It's effective yet gentle enough for most skin types, with visible results that justify the cost. Overall, it's a luxurious and effective serum that does what it promises.
A little goes a long way. No harsh or unwanted side effects (my skin type is normal to combination). With continuous use, it helped made my skin feel refreshed.

This product was received at no cost in exchange for my honest review. I followed instructions very carefully and used it as recommended. I have to say it has a similar effect to retinol with prescription. I was a little concerned about using it during the day but it worked great. Ay the end of the second week i started feeling my skin a lot drier and scales would come off. I stopped using it during the day and just used it at night. I believe I'll need to wait a little longer to see visible results in my skin but one thing is for sure, it has that exfoliating effect that renews the skin.
I've used this for a week, and it feels great. It'll take a bit more time to see whether there are visible results, but I shall keep using it!

Perricone MD's High Potency Triple Retinol Renewal Serum is worth the purchase. I haven't been using it long enough to determine its long-term effects, but so far, it's working just as well, if not better, than my go-to nonprescription retinol serum. Everything about this retinol from Perricone is a joy to use. From the minimal plastic in the packaging, the feel of the glass and labels, and the texture of the creamy serum, it all feels very high quality.

I love a good retinol & I highly recommend this one from Perricone MD. If you're looking to tighten your skin and get rid of fine lines I would add this retinol to your skin care routine with a good moisturizer! You will definitely see improvements in your skin.

avis.titre: Great Serum for my nighttime skincare routine
avis.texte: Great serum to add to my nightly skincare routine! I've had to cut back my excessive use of retinol and exfoliants on my skin because my skin was becoming so resistant and tolerant to everything. The first time I used this I felt a slight tingle which I haven't felt in years and was elated. I've added this serum to my nightly skincare routine and it's been perfect. No weird smells, it absorbs quickly and I can use it daily.

I received this product to try. I have used other PerriconeMd products before and this is great. I have oily skin and this product seemed to normalize that. I don't get oily through the day but I'm also not dry or peeling or anything like that. It works well with my makeup. Has a herbal scent. I feel like I need to try it longer to see the other effects but I do see that my complexion is clearer. And it seems like it's helped reduce the look of my pores. I took a star off for the scent- it doesn't last long but I'm not a fan.
I love this ! It was light and didn't feel heavy on my skin. I could tell a difference within days.
I was so excited to try this product. I truly enjoy using this renewal serum. It leaves your skin feeling soft, refreshed, and younger looking. Who doesn't want younger healthier skin. Love it!

I am 51 years old and have lived in Florida nearly my entire adult life. I have a skincare routine that includes multiple products, cleansers, toners, serums, hyaluronic acid, Vitamin C, moisturizers, SPF, and face oils. Adding Perricone MD's High Potency Triple Retinol Renewal Serum into my routine has made a visible difference in the fine lines around my eyes and overall texture after only 4 weeks of daily use. I use it in the evening because I use Vitamin C in the morning. I have slowly been adding medical grade products into my routine and am very glad I came across this product as it's not terribly expensive and works well. I am happy with the results and will be including this as part of my daily routine - I'd be happy to recommend it to anyone considering adding a retinol product to their skincare lineup.

avis.titre: Love this serum and Perricone product
avis.texte: This is a first for using the High Potency Triple Retinol Renewal Serum, but have used many of the other products from Perricone MD, and this serum did not disappoint. The serum went on smooth and not sticky, and absorbed into my skin quickly. It did not have a strong smell. My face looks and feels more hydrated and my makeup went on smooth after using. I will continue to use this serum.

This is the smoothest most moisturizing retinol serum I've ever used. Typically my skin will peel or feel irritated the next morning after use. With this one, it feels hydrated and instantly smooth!!!

avis.titre: A staple in my skin care regimen!
avis.texte: Perricone MD High Potency Retinok Serum has been a game changer in my skin care regimen! It's great for those that have a sensitive sniffer as there is no scent. The texture is lightweight. The pump bottle gives out just the right amount as a little goes a long way with this product. I see this lasting a long time. I love that it doesn't feel heavy or greasy on the skin. It gives my skin a subtle glow. My skin can be fussy and sensitive sometimes and I have had zero irritation with this product. Overall, it's been a valued addition to my skin care routine and I look forward to seeing more results as I continue to use. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

As I get into the my middle aged-ness, retinol is starting to become a bigger part of my skincare arsenal. The serum came with a nice pump and the bottle is dark which I have always understood was how a good retinol should be stored. The serum so far has been working well with the rest of my skincare routine. I have not yet gotten to the retinol breakout purge on my skin yet but I know it likely is coming. Will continue to pay attention to how this helps. My skin is nice and soft since I started using this.

I absolutely loved this high potency triple retinol renewal serum by Perricone MD. It immediately addressed the concerns I had with my fine lines, wrinkles, and my enlarged pores. This serum was tough on these issues but soft and gentle on my skin. I highly recommend to anyone wanting brighter, more youthful looking skin.

I used this product every morning and night and have noticed great results. Face is left feeling plump and soft while looking young and hydrated. It's a perfect addition to any skincare routine. Especially with results like these. Blends well into the skin and isn't sticky or anything.

Been using this retinol serum for about a month & am impressed! My skin is smoother and plumper without irritation or peeling that I normally get from a retinol. Light hydrating texture with no scent. Love!

avis.titre: This serum is one of my new nightly favorites ??
avis.texte: I'm thrilled with this retinol serum! It's been a game-changer in my skincare routine. It's effective, gentle, and works seamlessly with all my other products, so I didn't have to adjust anything. No strong or unpleasant odor, which is a big plus for me, and I've definitely seen improvements without any issues. Highly recommend for anyone looking to add retinol to their routine without the fuss!
I love the way this serum makes my face look! Great results in a very short time. Also, my skin feels so soft. Not sticky like some serums are. Definitely give it a try. I am a customer for life!

When I received this product, I added it my face routine for day and night. I started to experience a little sensitivity around my mouth, so I cut back to night only. After using for just a couple of weeks, I have noticed that the dark spots on my cheeks have started to fade. I definitely recommend this serum as an everyday retinol solution.

I received this product free to try by BzzAgent. I use in the evening before moisturizer. It has an elegant texture that is a pleasure to apply. In the few days I have used it I can say my short term results are no skin peeling, sensitivity or redness, which can occur with strong retinol products.

Love this product! It smells great, goes on light, not at all sticky 2 pumps covers my face and neck, and it's super light. It has completely changed the texture of my skin for the better. I noticed a dirrerence immediately. Product really helps to plump up the skin all over my face, but especially around my eyes and mouth think I've had it a few weeks now, my skin looks more radiance & feels so smooth.

I've been using it for two full weeks now, morning and night, and I've noticed a marked improvement in my skin. Fine lines look smoothed, my skin texture is smoother/more even, and I feel like my skin look radiant! Definitely pleased with the results!

avis.titre: A skincare product that offers great results
avis.texte: I use this product two times each day. During the initial week, I observed that certain regions felt a bit more solid. In the second week, I noticed that my face and neck looked more toned and firm. I'm delighted to see that a few fine lines are fading away. A number of my friends mentioned that I appear younger. I will certainly think about incorporating this product into my everyday skincare regimen. I recommend this product for someone who is looking a skincare product that offers great results.
I really really like it!!! I use it at night time and when I wake up my skin looks so fresh and my face smooth like a baby bum!!! I can honestly say that this is my favorite!! THE BEST :)

avis.titre: One of a kind hydrating retinol
avis.texte: The base of this retinol is what makes it so great. It's a hydrating serum texture that IMO is pretty unique. I love that it's hydrating to help combat the dryness that comes with most retinols. I started with once a week bc it's definitely still powerful. I had to avoid using it under my eyes (which I do to try to treat my crows feet) because I did get some sensitivity and a bit of "breakouts" there, but that's common for me as I can't even use eye creams without getting a little bit of a breakout. So if you're sensitive under the eyes, just avoid the whole eye area. However I didn't really have any other issues with using it all over, I did get a little dryness but was prepared for it and used a hydrating cream after this serum each time to help. I haven't used it long enough to speak to long term results but I can say when I do use it I wake up to happy, glowing skin and not nearly the amount of dryness I get with other retinol products. A+!

I received a free sample of Perricone MD High Potency Triple Retinol Renewal Serum and I loved it! Please note: I have been using a retinol from another company for a year and experienced irritation for about a month when I started using it and I only use it every other day to reduce the irritation. In order to test Perricone MD's gentleness, I used it every day for three weeks. I experienced NO irritation and I saw a slight improvement in my skin, probably because I was able to use the serum everyday. I'd highly recommend this if you have irritation from other retinols!

avis.titre: This is a really nice retinol+ serum!
avis.texte: I've been using this for a few weeks now & I really, really love it! I like that it's got encapsulated retinol because that way it won't be as affected by oxygen, I also love that they it has 3 types of retinol. They also included Coenzyme Q10 for discoloration & Beta-Carotene for dullness, texture & to protect and boost the retinol. It's really helping fade my sunspots. I live at the beach and spend too much time outside, even with reapplying SPF regularly the sun definitely damaged my skin. This is one of the few skincare products that actually helps fade that damage & discoloration. I recently saw a lot of family members & several told me that my skin looked great! That is not a compliment I'm used to getting! I'll definitely keep buying this serum after I'm done with this one.

avis.titre: A great addition to my skimcare routine
avis.texte: I have been using this serum for the past 2 weeks and I am really liking it. The texture is light and easy to spread evenly. I started using it on alternate nights, to make sure my skin would not get irritated and had no issue, now I use it every night and feel my skin softer and luminous.

avis.titre: Might work/Might not. I've only had it a week.
avis.texte: I'm not done analyzing this product. I've got 5 emails in the past three days asking when I'm going to review or that my time is running out to review this. I've only had it about a week and a half and I started out using it twice a week and that's as far as I've gotten. So I have no idea how this performs, what the long term effects are, whether it's for sensitive skin or not, I'd like to know if you can actually use it day and night like the packaging states.

Have used retinol products before and since getting this one have loved it even more. Smells great and goes in smooth. Have seen results and would recommend it to anyone wanting a great retinol. If you're not sure try it!! I was given this product for free in exchange for my honest review and this review is my honest opinion while using this product.

Wow I loved the Perricone MD High Potency Triple Retinol. I've been using it morning and night and it leaves my skin looking smooth, dewy, and youthful. My new favorite retinol product. I received this product for free in exchange for writing a review.

avis.titre: I would definitely buy this again!
avis.texte: I have been using this product every morning and evening after washing my face. It goes on really nicely.. super smooth and blends in great. There is no tacky stickiness whatsoever, I absolutely love the consistency! It has made a slight difference in my skin in the slight amount of time that I've been using it.. I definitely feel like my skin is smoother and more radiant. I would definitely buy this product again!

avis.titre: I will definitely be purchasing more when I run out!
avis.texte: I have been using this serum at night after washing my face for the last two weeks. So far, I really like it. The serum is light, with no strong fragrance, and a little goes a long way. I have received multiple comments from friends and family about how luminous my face looks without make up. Unlike other retinol treatments, I have tried, this one is very gentle, and I've had no irritation or dryness. I was sent a sample to try in exchange for an honest review. I would 100% recommend this and I will definitely be purchasing more when I run out!

I've been using two pumps of this serum twice daily and have easily added it into my skin care routine. While I noticed cell turnover within the first few days of use, it has been gentle to my skin. I haven't had any irritation as previously experienced with other retinol based products. Thanks to Perricone MD for the free High Potency Triple Retinol Renewal Serum.

avis.titre: I wish I could give it 6 stars!
avis.texte: I received Perricone MD High Potency Triple Renewal Serum to try from BzzAgent in exchange for my review on it. I am 43, had acne my entire adult life until a few years ago when I started noticing signs of aging instead. I have been searching for a product to help hydrate my skin without causing breakouts. After just a few uses of this product I had a glow in my skin, dry skin was gone, sunspot freckles started lightening and my skin felt hydrated and refreshed!!! I will use this product for the rest of my life!! After applying the serum there was no tightness, stinging, no strong scent, my face felt so smooth, hydrated and amazing. I've been using it for a few weeks now and this is the best single skincare product I have ever tried. I have tried prescription retinol and this is 200X better and doesn't dry your skin! I literally don't have one thing that I could say negative about this product or one thing I would change. It's the best thing I have ever put on my skin!!!

I apply this daily right after I shower and I've been using this for about two weeks and it has drastically reduced my appearance of pores, reduced the redness of scaring on my face, and helped with my uneven skin tone. I love that it helps with all 3 of my problem areas and that it goes on smooth and doesn't leave a sticky appearance once it dries. My face feels firmer and looks brighter since I've been using this product.

The Perricone MD Triple Retinol Renewal serum is thciker than the serums I have used in the past.. It goes on like a lotion. The serum quickly absobs and is very hydrating. It doesn't dry out my skin. I can see small wrinkles thinning out. I will contunie to use in hopes that my wrinkles thin out even more. The bottle seems to last longer than the liquid serums since it is thicker. I would highly recommend this product to my friends and family.

Been using the retinol serum for few weeks now and I'm loving how my skin looks and feels! Easy to use, non greasy, absorbs quickly without drying out my skin. Very gentle on the skin. Doesn't have much of a scent , skin feels and looks amazing after use

I received the Perricone MD High Potency Triple Retinol Renewal Serum complimentary in exchange for my honest review. I used the serum morning and night for three weeks and didn't see much of a difference. I did however notice that the serum started irritating the sensitive skin below my eyes. It felt like slight burning. And I noticed this about 2 weeks into the trial. I don't know that I'd recommend this product only because of the lack of change to my skin.

Now that I've given this product time to work, I definitely saw a different in my skin. I noticed that it was more radiant, smoother and less dull. There was no initial irritation while using this. I was impress that it says day and night but I was still careful in ensuring I used just enough and spf. I also notice a difference in my uneven skin tone around jaw line area. I think the pump idea was good, probably still prepare capsules or maybe a dropper. Overall I think this high end retinol was great.

Ive been using this product for two weeks now and it's done wonders on my skin. Its helped unclog my pores. Helped the texture of my skin. It has reduced the smile lines around my skin and given me all around soft, hydrated plump skin. My skin looks glowy after using it. Would highly recommend. Gifted by perricone md.

avis.titre: Good Product, Not for Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: This retinol works well and definitely makes my skin smoother, however, I wouldn't recommend it for people with sensitive skin. It is one of those products where you need to work your way up to using it more than once a week. It is easy to apply and I like that it feels like a serum. I would recommend this to friends/family.

I've only been using this for 13 days now, I'm 36. I don't have wrinkles, yet, but I have lack of elasticity and fine lines. I noticed my eye lines "crows feet" appear lighter or finer. Love it so far
The Perricone triple retinol serum has made my skin feel smoother and brighter in just a few days of using it. I am going to add this to my skincare routine and highly recommend!

I received this product for free in exchange for an honest review, and I wanted to give myself two weeks before I reviewed this serum. I only needed three days before I saw amazing results. This serum is light, non-greasy, fast absorbing and does not pill under other products and makeup. I absolutely love it. Fine lines are smoothed out and undetectable, my skin is so soft, and my face stays hydrated all day. I need about four pumps of the product for my whole face and neck. No irritation or redness and no breakouts. I will continue using this!

As someone who mistakenly looks younger than I actually am, I'm no stranger to retinol. Rentinol are a game changer when it comes to changing the texture of my skin in my opinion. But as I get older for some reason I find my skin becoming more sensitive, so I've been taking a break from retinol because of it. I can't express enough how happy I am that this product works just as good and I can use in the daytime and follow up with a sunscreen. For sensitive skin girlies, who are curious about retinol, I definitely recommend to give this one a try.

avis.titre: A new staple in my skincare routine
avis.texte: I've been using this product every night for a week, and I can definitely see a difference in my forehead lines! I will definitely continue to purchase. Highly recommend!!

Retinol has become a staple in my skincare and I have used other brands as well. This product feels luxurious especially the packaging. It absorbs in the skin pretty quickly. Although it is too early to see a visible difference in the skin but overall. No dryness or irritation noted. I love that it has Niacinamide for my acne prone skin.

avis.titre: Amazing serum if you are looking for results!
avis.texte: I use this product directly after cleansing my face. I allow my face to dry and then apply a small pea size amount. It blends in easily and smoothly. I have plenty of product left even after 30 days. My skin is brighter and smoother since using this product.
I started applied the product as directed and noticed my skin peeling a bit,this happens when using retinoids. But being consistent and moisturizing the peeling has stopped and my skin feels amazing!

I have been using this product primarily at night. I have noticed brighter more even toned skin with no signs of irritation. I like the consistency of the formula and the feel on my skin. I would love to see the results over a longer time

From the first use, I loved the Perricone ME high potency triple retinol renewal serum. I was skeptical because retinol has irritated so many people's skin, but this does not, in face it feels great on my skin! Just a little bit goes a long way.

My skin can be reactive to some retinols, but this is one of the better ones. Mild smell and not too drying. I woke up with noticeably glowy skin that wasn't red or irritated. My makeup even seemed to go on more smoothly, so I think I'm going to add this to my routine.

I use this product regularly as part of my skincare routine. Although I haven't noticed a difference yet, I do like the product and will continue to use it. I am sure that the results will come. I am happy with it.

This serum is absolutely amazing. I can't say enough about it. First off it goes on silky smooth and leaves your skin feeling soft and moisturized and the brightening effects are amazing. I noticed it after only 2 uses! If you haven't tried this yet go get some you will not regret it!

I had high hopes for the Perricone MD High Potency Retinol Recovery Serum, and it's safe to say it didn't disappoint! Since retinol is a key player in smoothing fine lines and improving skin texture, I was excited to see how this serum would work on some unevenness and early signs of aging I've started noticing. Right off the bat, I loved the lightweight texture – it absorbs quickly, leaving no sticky feeling behind, which is a big plus. At first, I was cautious, using it just a few nights a week since I know retinol can sometimes be intense, especially on my sensitive skin. I didn't experience any irritation, just a slight tingling on the first few uses, which told me it was working. After a few weeks, I began to see subtle improvements. My skin looked a bit smoother and brighter, and I noticed some softening of the fine lines around my eyes and mouth. I can see this serum becoming a staple in my routine, especially because it feels like a good balance of potent yet gentle retinol, which is hard to find. It's a splurge, but for anyone wanting visible anti-aging benefits without overwhelming their skin, it's a solid investment.

I've been using this high potency triple retinol renewal serum for a couple of weeks now, and I'm impressed with the results. It has noticeably improved the texture of my skin, reducing fine lines and giving me a smoother, more even complexion. The serum is potent and definitely does what it promises. One thing to note is that it does dry out the skin a bit, which is common with strong retinols. But with a good moisturizer to follow up, it's totally manageable and worth the results. Overall, if you're looking for a retinol that actually works, this serum works!
I was gifted the serum from Perricone MD. I've used it for about 3 weeks as directed and I absolutely love it! My skin feels plumper, tighter and smoother. Usually can't use retinol every day.

avis.titre: I will definitely be purchasing again.
avis.texte: This is great and goes on so good. Goes on smoothly and feels light weight.

I received this product and began using it nightly. It has a light texture and no scent which I love. My face did feel a bit smoother immediately after product use. Depending on its price point I'm not sure if I would recommend it to others as I feel it works the same as many other retinols I've tried in the past.

The product works great! I've had noticeable improvement in my dark spots and my pores appear just a tad smaller. I've only been using this for a little under two weeks, so I'm excited to see what happens with the remainder.

avis.titre: You will want to try this one
avis.texte: I am a 53 year old woman who loves skincare. I have been using this Triple Retinol Renewal serum at night for about a month. I am using 1 pump, warming it up in my hands and then applying all over my face. This serum is silky smooth, doesn't really have any fragrance and absorbs beautifully. I have noticed my skin being softer, smoother, and even a little brighter. I have not been using a cream overtop because I am a little oily. I have had zero peeling or redness from this retinol serum. I have really enjoyed this serum and I would recommend it to anyone looking for a good anti aging product.

I received this lovely Perricone MD High Potency Triple Retinol Renewal Serum for free in exchange for writing my honest review. For me I really like that this serum goes on easy, absorbs quickly and does not leave your face feeling sticky. I noticed it does help reduce the look of fine lines which is always what I'm looking for with a product. It doesn't have a scent when applying that I noticed which I really like. I plan to continue using this serum for my morning skincare routine so I would buy it when I need too.

Its light weight. absorbs quickly. Doesn't have a smell.. so far I've noticed how glowy my skin is, smoother and hydrated. Definitely will repurchase once I run out! It's so luxe and needs to be added to your skin routine

I love this company and have many different products from them! I was excited to try this out! It seems to do a great job, not much is needed. I will say because of the high potency, I can't use it more than a couple times a week, otherwise my skin feels dried out.

I love Dr Perricone's products as they are always very high quality. This one is no different. I have been using this serrum morning and night and it helps with my main issue of uneven skin tone and hyperpigmentation. I am very pleased to note that my dark spots seem to be fading and I do not need as much foundation. I love this product and will definitely buying another bottle.

avis.titre: I would recommend this product for better skin!
avis.texte: I got this product in hopes to help with dull skin and it lived up to my expectations! I use it nightly and have found improvement in skin tone- seems to be less dull and feel more of a glow.

I've used prescription retinols in the past and feel this is very similar. It does make your skin a little peely at first, which is the same experience I had with the prescription. It's not bad and is fine after a few days once your skin is used to the product. It's doing its job of skin renewal, so if your skin is already in need of an exfoliation, this is what to expect. Maybe don't start using it a couple days before a big event until you know how you will react. Like all retinol products, you need to use sunscreen (you should use sunscreen even without a retinol). The packaging is nice and the quantity should last a long time. You only need a pump or so. As to the previous comment, maybe bast to use it sparingly at 1st to lessen any initial reaction, I didn't and I know better. In the end you'll end up with brighter skin.

My skin is loving this retinol. I have been using it consistently nightly for two weeks and I swear my skin looks and feels younger. Compared to other retinols, this one has no scent and doesn't dry my skin out. I'm loving this as part of my night time skin care routine.

I've been using the serum for about 2 weeks now and I have noticed my uneven skin tone improving. My face looks brighter and it feels more plumped. The serum itself is very lightweight and has a very slight scent. I use under makeup everyday, after toner and I make sure to use spf after it and my makeup still looks flawless:

avis.titre: My lines are disappearing more and more.
avis.texte: Love this product. Easy to use dispenser and a little goes a long way. I have noticed over the past few weeks that my age lines are getting smaller and less visible. My skin seems to be firming up as well. My deeper lines are minimized and my smaller ones are disappearing. Definitely will continue to use this. I was provided this sample for my honest opinion.

My skin definitely feels and look better after using this. I absolutely love this serum! First, it has no scent, which is perfect for anyone with sensitive skin. Second, even though it's labeled as an "intensive serum," it absorbs quickly without feeling oily or sticky. My skin feels incredibly smooth after each use. I'll definitely be purchasing it again!
Love the fact this product is unsented. I have noticed smoother skin with twice a day use over the past two weeks. Will continue to use to see more results.

avis.titre: High Potency Triple Retinol Renewal Serum
avis.texte: I've been using this serum for about four weeks now, morning and night, and I've seen difference, especially with my hyperpigmentation and fine lines around my eyes. Definitely a keeper in my routine!

avis.titre: Great addition to skin care routine
avis.texte: I have been using this everyday for 3 weeks and loving it!! The serum is so smooth and velvety. My skin doesn't feel sticky or tight after application. No dryness or irritation. A skin care must!

I really love that this product can be used in either the AM or PM, making it a really versatile anti-aging serum. The serum absorbs quickly and doesn't irritate, making it perfect for even sensitive skin. After consistent use, my skin feels firmer, more hydrated, and has a healthy glow. This is a must-have for anyone seeking effective anti-aging results.

avis.titre: Smoother skin and more radiant texture in 2 weeks
avis.texte: I've been using the Perricone MD High Potency Triple Retinol Renewal Serum for a couple of weeks now, and I'm really impressed. The serum feels lightweight and absorbs quickly, leaving no greasy residue behind. After about a week of use, I noticed my skin felt smoother, with fine lines looking less noticeable. My skin tone also appeared more even and radiant, which was great for combating the dullness I'd been dealing with. I love how it's helping keep my skin looking youthful and refreshed. One important step I always make sure to follow is using sunscreen every morning, since retinol can make your skin more sensitive to the sun. Overall, I'm really happy with how my skin looks and feel confident continuing to use it as part of my nighttime routine. If you're looking for a high-potency retinol serum with visible results, I highly recommend giving this one a try!
I could tell a difference after 3 days. I used the serum at night on clean skin. I did not experience any discomfort or irritation from the serum. My skin is soft and smooth!
A little goes a long way. I love how easily it goes on and how smooth it leaves the skin, not greasy or oily at all. Loving the effects of this. Can't wait to see how the effects grow over time.

Thank you Perricone MD for the free High Potency Triple Retinol Renewal Serum! I have been using this serum now for 3 weeks as part of my nightly routine, and my skin has never looked better. I have extremely sensitive skin, but this serum has been very gentle. My fine lines look softened and some of my dark spots lighter. It's also hydrating. Highly recommend!

I received this product as part of a sampling program. This product far exceeded my expectations!! My skin is extremely more radiant after one week of use. The texture of my skin is so much better as well. Unlike other retinol products I've used in the past this one did not irritate my skin.

(Gifted by Perricone MD in exchange for my honest review) I'm turning 40 in a month, so I'm very interested in finding my perfect retinol. My skin is fair, showing the very first signs of static wrinkles, and I have mild sun damage from living through the 00s tanning bed craze as a teen. Something different about this is you can use it night AND day. I'd never heard of retinol safe to use during the day, so I was immediately intrigued! (Of course, make sure you use a sunscreen after day time use.) It's definitely not as harsh as other retinols I've used. Even using it twice a day for the last 2 weeks, my skin isn't sensitive or red, and there's no sign of the dreaded retinol flakies. I can put it around my eyes without worry. It's too early to judge effects on my fine lines, but my skin is brighter and more even, and the orange peel texture and large pores on my cheeks have improved. The serum itself is a thin texture, and spreads easily. It plays well with my hydrating toner, serums, and water cream moisturizer. I do recommend this product. Perricone is an established, science based brand with a proven track record. I'm always confident I'll get results with their products, and the High Potency Triple Retinol Renewal Serum is another winner to add to my line up.

avis.titre: The milky texture is wonderful and the pump bottle is so ...
avis.texte: This is definitely different than other retinols that I have used but I really like this because the texture is great and a nice consistency. Not watery and I love that the bottle doesn't come with a droplet like some other retinol serums come with. It makes it so much easier to apply and take around with me! The other thing that I liked is that it did not irritate my skin, make me dry or red. Which was wonderful!

avis.titre: Super soft and light weight serum!
avis.texte: Thanks to Perricone MD give me the chance to try free High Potency Triple Retinol Renewal Serum! Serum has no smell (which I love), super light weight, it blended to my skin easily. Love it!

the best serum for facial skin, I used it for two weeks and the result is already visible, the skin is more elastic and toned, the serum does not dry the skin, does not leave a sticky feeling, it is very light and absorbs quickly. You only need a small amount for application. It is convenient to use both day and night.
